title: Ryu-Takayanagi area from Virasoro modular data
summary: We show that in holographic 2d CFTs, the entanglement entropies across several choices of global state and subregion can be written in a way that at once has a microscopic interpretation and matches the leading large$-c$ organization of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula. This representation is obtained by applying crossing symmetry to the replica manifolds.
